Title: Generally available: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 66 - February 2023

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components.  

 

Mobility Service – Added Linux support for: 

  • Azure to Azure - Ubuntu 22.04, RHEL 8.7, and Cent OS 8.7 
  • Modernized VMware/Physical to Azure - Ubuntu 22.04, RHEL 8.7, and Cent OS 8.7 
  • Classic VMware/Physical to Azure - RHEL 8.7 and Cent OS 8.7 

 

This update also provides bug fixes.  

Learn more about the issues fixed and get the download links.
